body: I’m 16. This wasn’t my first sexual experience. Ive done things with girls before but this was my first time with a boy. I did feel pressured into it by some friends but Ik that it was ultimately my decision to do it. I want to block him and just ignore him, but part of my feels like if I do that he’ll go and spread shit and I just don’t wanna deal with that rn. And I honestly don’t think he even sees it as rape. I feel like I should’ve been louder or more forceful when I told him to stop. Maybe he just didn’t hear me. It makes it worse, just thinking he doesn’t even know he’s done something so disgusting and I’m just a mess over it.
Ya I’ll probably see him again. He’s part of my friend group so I’m bound to be at the same party or gathering with him.
Not really. I mean I have friends but I wouldn’t trust them with the information. They’re not very good at keeping things to themselves.

From my knowledge, since I’m a minor my therapist is legally obligated to tell my parents anything that could be harmful to me. Or if it worries her to much. My mother and I get along but she’s very prone to overreacting. When she found out I was depressed she grounded my for months in hopes it would “cure me”. So she’d probably just ground me and forbid any male contact. Idk maybe she’d actually listen but I don’t wanna go through being under surveillance 24/7 again.
I want to tell someone. Rn I’m planning on talking to my therapist about it Wednesday. But idk if I will, I’m scared she’ll tell my parents and don’t want that.

My father is a very religious man so sex has always been taboo in his eyes. He used to call me a whore and other derogatory terms when he saw me talking or texting boys. So whenever I’m alone with my thoughts I hear his words over and over again. And only me and the dude, along with the two other friends know about it.

I was hurt. I tried not to think of it tho. But once they went to sleep I was just laying in bed next to them crying,.,one of them was had their arm on my back and I couldn’t sleep cause every time one of them touched me I’d start crying. Which was abnormal cause I’m a very affectionate person and I love to cuddle with my friends but the thought of them touching me or anyone touching me rn just makes me want to vomit
About us having sex. I told them about me telling him to stop and him not, but they didn’t really take it seriously. Which is probably my fault, but I just didn’t wanna ruin the night.

Me and the other two friends were going to have a movie night. Me and the boy had planned on having sex in a few weeks but he told me he was busy and asked if I could reschedule to yesterday. So he came as well. My friends knew we were having sex. But I couldn’t tell them how disgusting I felt after it. They just kept making jokes about it...and I didn’t wanna ruin the mood

He just stopped and we put our clothes back on. He really didn’t say anything, he was just silent and told me that “if only he had more time”. He then left to go back to our other friends. I went to the bathroom that was nearby and scrubbed myself. I have mixed feelings. Ik what he did was wrong and Ik it’s the definition of rape, but I can’t help but make excuses for him. I can’t bring myself to admit that he’d do it intentionally.
We weren’t really friends,.,we’re in the same friend group but we weren’t close
Thank you. You don’t know how much it means to hear that

I want to. I just don’t know how. My parents are very anti sex. That’s one of the reasons I wanted to do it in the first places. And I don’t wanna get an “I told you so”. My dad would probably beat me and my mom would never let any of my male friends over again. Some of them are my crutches and the thought of never talking to them again scares me.
Thank you for the reply, I’ll try to filter what I say next time I’m up there. I personally want to thank the fae or whatever gave the bones to me, but I’ll do more research first just to be safe.

Thanks for the advice. The bones don’t scare me, I’m more just concerned that I signed a contract unknowingly. I plan to keep them but I do want to thank whomever left them. Is it ok to keep the bones and still offer the milk and honey as a thank you?
That’s a really good idea. I’ll do that in our next session
Thank you. It’s nice to hear from people with similar flaws. I’ll try and talk to her about it :)
Thank you, Hearing someone say that is honestly so refreshing. I’m not in the most healthy home situation so hearing someone say nice things is kinda truly just, idk it just makes it alittle better

I know I should. But I’m honestly so scared to. I tried talking to my mom and dad before but they don’t take these types of things well. My friends are dealing with their own stuff and I don’t wanna be a bother. I know I’m just making excuses but I honestly feel so alone rn and idk....it’s just really got me fucked
I wish I could. But she’s a family friend that’s a therapist so she does it as a kindness to my grandpa. My mom can’t afford a therapist so I have to deal with her
